about: Golden cases for City builder massing (GEV-CITY-1112). src/data/cityMassing.test.mjs and src/data/citySun.test.mjs hold the code to them; the dream loop's planspec validator reads the same file. res_share and site_coverage are separate quantities: the 3 m setback case tells them apart.

definitions.plot_m2: plot area in the play grid's metric (a grid plot is its 40 m x 40 m cell)
definitions.setback_m: every plot edge moves inward by this; the footprint is what is left
definitions.footprint_m2: area of the plot inset by setback_m
definitions.res_share: residential share of floor area, assumed, dimensionless
definitions.unit_m2: floor area of one home, assumed
definitions.homes: floor(floor_area_m2 x res_share / unit_m2), shown as HOMES n EST
definitions.shadow_reach_m: height_m / tan(sun_altitude_deg) on level ground, shown as SHADOW REACH n m EST (rounded to whole metres)
